devices.title: Access point
devices.//guard: Bands and SSIDs named here are refused by every write capability, before the driver is called. Use it for a band that is carrying something you must not interrupt.

policy.//confirmWrites: Capabilities that change device state are refused unless the caller passes confirm: true. Turning this off is not recommended when an agent is holding the MCP tools.
policy.//allowRestart: Reboot capabilities are not registered at all unless this is true.
policy.//hubBind: The hub holds admin credentials for every device listed above. Keep it on loopback unless you put an authenticating proxy in front.
